words.definition: The act or process of rebuilding or restoring something, especially after damage or destruction
words.definationTranslation: किसी चीज को नुकसान या विनाश के बाद पुनः निर्माण या पुनर्स्थापन करने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: The government has initiated a reconstruction program to rebuild the damaged infrastructure in the war-torn city.
sentence.translation: सरकार ने युद्ध से प्रभावित शहर में क्षतिग्रस्त बुनियादी ढांचे को पुनर्निर्माण करने के लिए एक कार्यक्रम शुरू किया है।

sentence.sentence: The international community is providing aid for the reconstruction of the country after the devastating conflict.
sentence.translation: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समुदाय युद्ध के बाद देश के पुनर्निर्माण के लिए सहायता प्रदान कर रहा है।

words.definition: The process of restoring someone to a normal or healthy state, especially after illness, injury, or imprisonment
words.definationTranslation: किसी को बीमारी, चोट या कैद के बाद सामान्य या स्वस्थ अवस्था में बहाल करने की प्रक्रिया

sentence.sentence: The rehabilitation center provides counseling and job training to help former prisoners reintegrate into society.
sentence.translation: पुनर्वास केंद्र पूर्व कैदियों को समाज में पुनः एकीकरण में मदद करने के लिए परामर्श और नौकरी प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करता है।

sentence.sentence: The government has launched a rehabilitation program to help victims of the conflict rebuild their lives.

words.definition: The process of becoming a part of a group or society again, especially after being separated or isolated
words.definationTranslation: एक समूह या समाज का हिस्सा बनने की प्रक्रिया, विशेष रूप से अलग या अलग-थलग होने के बाद

sentence.sentence: The organization provides support to help refugees reintegrate into their host communities.

words.definition: The process of disbanding or disarming a military force, especially after a conflict

sentence.sentence: The international community is calling for disarmament and demilitarization in the conflict zone.

words.definition: The process of making something stable or secure, especially in a political or economic sense

words.definition: The state of being responsible or answerable for one's actions
